name: @gjsify/integration-domparser
description: Integration tests: @gjsify/domparser against parse5 and css-select on GJS and Node. Differential — the same canonicalizer reads both trees and the same selectors run through both engines, so a divergence is a finding rather than an opinion (ADR 0026).

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
